svg.text: How Nemotron 3.5 Lightning routes tokens through sparse experts

An auxiliary objective spreads tokens over experts,
so none is starved or a bottleneck.

128 routed experts + always-on layers (all resident in memory)
≈10% of the weights do the work for each token
active ≈ always-on layers (Mamba-2, attention, embeddings) + 6/128 of the expert weights ≈ 3B
